test.command: python -m pytest tests/test_forward_paper_account_bridge.py tests/test_paper_order_lifecycle.py tests/test_forward_session_runner.py -q; ruff check src/financial_brain/forward_edge/paper_execution_adapter.py src/financial_brain/forward_edge/paper_account_bridge.py tests/test_forward_paper_account_bridge.py

implemented: Runner API durably records order updates during the execution callback.
MarketableQuoteSimulator lifecycle updates are bound by ForwardPaperSessionService and durably streamed before terminal receipt processing.
Lifecycle validates stable update identities, states, monotonic timestamps and cumulative quantities; canceled partial fills remain explicit.
Journal projection and the read-only cockpit display exact requested, filled and remaining quantities and update history.
Missing requested quantity is rendered UNKNOWN; no complete-fill assumption is made.
Crash recovery test covers streamed order update journal boundaries.
blockers: No observed forward market session verifies an end-to-end rendered order history.
